style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 45cm Pre Lit Red Berry Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <p>A real Christmas classic, this pre lit Red Berry Wreath combines abundant greenery with rich red berries and sparkly fairy lights to bring joy and good cheer to your festivities. A thick circle of faux fir and sprays of winter berries are set onto a natural twig base, and 50 warm white LED fairy lights are woven into the foliage to give the wreath a beautiful glow. </p><p>A clear cable runs between the base and the battery box for ease of styling. This wreath is the perfect choice for a sheltered front door under a porch or for bringing inside and popping up over the mantlepiece to accompany mince pies and a crackling fire.</p><p>To illuminate, simply insert 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Use the optional 6 hour timer for automatic illumination at the same time each evening. </p><p>All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions.</p><ul><li>(D) 50cm </li><li>Inner Diameter 25cm </li><li>Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)</li><li>Optional 6 hour timer&nbsp;</li><li>&nbsp;Size : ONE</li></ul>
